sections.heading: The price simulator
sections.body: Route calculation, price estimation and preparation of the WhatsApp message all happen entirely in your browser. No address or name you enter in the form is sent to our servers or stored by us.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: This processing relies on Article 6.1.b GDPR (pre-contractual steps taken at the data subject's request). No consent checkbox is required for this flow.

sections.heading: Mapping service
sections.body: Address autocomplete and route calculation use OpenRouteService. Addresses you type into the simulator are sent to this provider to perform that calculation. [TO BE COMPLETED — link to OpenRouteService's privacy policy, any transfer outside the EU]
